img.caption: Detail of side A, right: a nude, bearded man, standing profile to the right, holding a cock, faces a nude girl (?), who wears a taenia on her head and holds a flower in her upraised right hand and a wreath in her left hand, at waist level; another nude, bearded man, standing profile to the right, holding a crane in his upraised left hand, faces a nude youth, who wears a taenia on his head and holds an aryballos and a spear in his right hand; under the handle is crouched a nude, bearded man, profile to the right, who wears a taenia on his head and holds a small panther in his hands. img.caption: Detail of side A, left: Herakles, advancing profile to the right; he wears his lionskin, belted, over a short tunic, with his quiver slung over his left shoulder, and he holds his sword over his head (note also artist's signature, left, and Herakles' name, right)
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, bottom left: Eurytion, the herdsman, bearded, and wearing an animal skin over a tunic, belted, and a pilos, lies on the ground; an arrow runs through (behind?) his head, which is turned profile to the right; he grasps a weapon (?) in his right hand (note his name, retrograde, above his body)
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, top center: heads of Herakles and Geryon, on either side of the triple shield of Geryon (note also Herakle's name, to the right of Herakles' head)
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, top left: head of Herakles, with his lion-scalp helmet, shown profile to the right (note also Herakles' name, right)
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, top right: the triple-bodied monster, Geryon, wearing greaves, cuirasses over chitoniskoi, and helmets; two bodies are shown profile the left, aiming spears at Herakles, while the third, injured (note the red wound on his thigh) turns profile to the right, and points his shield down at the ground (note the labels naming Geryon, between the legs, and the kalos inscription, right)
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, top center: the heads of Geryon
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Close-up view of the figural scene on side B: Anchippos (a warrior) leaving home in a quadriga (four-horse chariot)

img.caption: Detail of side B, left: a charioteer and Anchippos (behind) standing on a chariotbox (note Anchippos' name, to the right of his head); the charioteer wears a nebris (animal skin), belted, over a long, sleeveless charioteer's tunic, while Anchippos wears a cuirass over a tunic, and a helmet, and holds a shield on his left arm and a spear in his left hand
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side B, top: a siren, wings outstretched, flies ahead of Anchippos (note Anchippos' name, to the right of his head); the charioteer wears a nebris (animal skin), belted, over a long, sleeveless charioteer's tunic, while Anchippos wears a cuirass over a tunic, and a helmet, and holds a shield on his left arm
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side B, right: a nude youth running to the left, with his head turned profile to the right, and both hands held behind him; another nude youth dancing over a lekythos; another nude youth dancing to the right, over a stamnos; he wears a chlamys draped over both arms and holds noise makers in both upraised hands

img.caption: View of side A, from below: feats of Herakles and Theseus

img.caption: Detail of side A, left: the Minotaur, running to the left, with his head profile to the right, grasps stones in each hand, while Theseus, running profile to the left, wearing a short-sleeved chitoniskos and a red wreath, grasps the Minotaur with his right hand, and a sword in his left hand
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, center: a nude, youthful Herakles, crouched profile to the right, wearing only a scabbard strap across his right shoulder and a red wreath on his head, wrestles with the Nemean lion, shown profile to the left, whose forepart is on the ground
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, left: Theseus, Herakles, and the Nemean lion; note the dipinto labelling Herakles, above his back
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, center: the upper body of Herakles, crouched profile to the right, wrestling with the Nemean lion, shown profile to the left, whose forepart is on the ground and whose rear end is raised
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, right: Prokrustes, nude, with long hair and a long beard, running to the left, although he turns his head profile to the right, facing Theseus, who pursues him, profile to the left, wielding an axe; Theseus is nude, except for a red wreath on his head
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Top view; the tondo shows a satyr with a maenad
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Close-up view of the tondo: a nude, ithyphallic, balding, bearded satyr, leans profile to the right, toward a woman who runs to the right, but turns her head profile to the left, to look at the satyr; she wears a short himation over a medium-sleeved chiton, while a sakkos covers her hair, and carries a kantharos in her right hand, and a thyrsos in her left hand
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of the tondo, top left: the torso and head of a nude, ithyphallic, balding, bearded satyr, leans profile to the right
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Bottom view: a rounded palmette, enclosed in a tendril, fills the space beneath each handle

img.caption: View of side A, from below: two youths on either side of a horse, who stands in front of a column
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, left: a youth, standing in a frontal pose, leaning on a staff under his left arm, and wearing a himation, turns his head profile to the right, and thrusts the palm of his hand, shown in a rare frontal pose, out towards the viewer; to his right stands another youth, dressed in Thracian boots (embades), a chitoniskos belted over a long overfold, a chlamys, and a (Thracian) fox-skin hat, reaches to the right, to stroke the nose of his horse
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, center: a horse stands profile to the left, in front of a schematic Ionic capital, supporting a narrow entablature; the horse is somewhat agitated, as indicated by his advancing left foot and the open lips
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, right of center: a youth, standing in a 3/4-view to the left, but leaning on a staff below his left arm, turns his head profile to the right, to look at another youth, who stands in near profile to the left, holds a staff in his left hand, and gestures with his opened right palm; both wear himatia
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: View of side B, from below: a man with youths
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: View of side B, left: two youths, wearing himatia, stand together and talk; the first is shown frontally, with his head turned profile to the right; he rests his right hand on his hip and holds a staff in his lowered left hand; the second youth stands profile to the left, facing him, and points his finger aggressively at the first youth
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: View of side B, center: a bearded man, wearing a himation around his legs and lower torso, sits profile to the right on a stool (diphros), rests his left hand on a staff, and holds his right hand over his head
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: View of side B, right: two youths, both wrapped in himation, stand together; the first, show profile to the left, tilts his head down slightly, and holds a staff beneath his right arm; the second, standing in a frontal pose, with his head turned profile to the right, reaches to touch the first youth on the shoulder
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Top view: the tondo depicts a woman with a basket, woman with a basket, between a door and an altar
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Close-up view of the tondo: a woman, wearing a himation over a medium-sleved chiton, an earring, and a sakkos, stands in a frontal view, and holds a large box in both hands; she looks profile to the left, at a door, behind her; to her right is a low altar crowned with a volute, from which flames billow
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Close-up view of the tondo: a woman, wearing a himation over a medium-sleved chiton, an earring, and a sakkos, stands in a frontal view, and holds a large box in both hands; she looks profile to the left, at a door, behind her
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Bottom view: note the palmettes, with volutes, underneath each handle
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: View of side A, from below: a woman standing in 3/4-view to the left, wearing a himation over a short-sleeved chiton, holds a hoop (wreath?) in her right hand, and turns her head profile to the right, to face another woman, who stands in a frontal pose, in front of a klismos (chair), is dressed like the first, but also wears a sakkos; she turns her head profile to the left to smell a rose; an Ionic column divides this woman from a third woman, who is entirely enveloped in a himation, draped over a chiton; she stands profile to the right and faces a cloth sack that hangs on the wall
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: View of side B, from below: a woman standing in 3/4-view to the right, in front of a klismos (chair), wearing a himation over a chiton, holds a unidentifiable object in her left hand; she faces another woman, who stands 3/4-view to the left, and reaches her right hand our in front of her; an Ionic column divides this woman from a third woman, who, dressed similarly to the first two, but also wears a sakkos on her head, stands in a frontal view, with her head turned profile to the left, and raises her arms, as if in fright
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Top view: the tondo depicts Linos and Mousaios
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Close-up view of the tondo: Mousaios, a nude youth wearing a white taenia, stands profile to the right, with his right hand on his hip, and holds a tablet in his upraised left hand; behind him is a footed box; in front of him, on a klismos, sits Linos, a bearded man wearing a himation around his lower body and a wreath; he unrolls a book scroll on which letters are barely distinguishable (note the dipinti labelling both figures)
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of the tondo, top: Mousaios, a nude youth wearing a white taenia, stands profile to the right, with his right hand on his hip, and holds a tablet in his upraised left hand; in front of him, on a klismos, sits Linos, a bearded man wearing a himation around his lower body and a wreath; he unrolls a book scroll on which letters are barely distinguishable (note the dipinti labelling both figures)

img.caption: Detail of side A, left: a bearded man (a trainer?), standing in a frontal pose, with his head turned profile to the left, wears a himation draped over his left shoulder and a white wreath; he holds a forked stick upright in his left hand
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, left of center: a nude athlete, wearing a white wreath, stands profile to the right; he holds halteres (jumping weights) ahead of his body, in both hands, and leans back
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side A, right: a nude athlete stands in a relaxed pose, profile to the right, seemingly talking with the woman opposite him, who stands 3/4-view to the left, and wears a himation over an undergarment, as well as a narrow taenia; (note the leaded clamp that repaired the break between them in antiquity)

img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of side B, right: an athlete, standing in a frontal pose, with his head profile to the right, holds his right arm directly to the left, and rests his left hand on his hip; next to him stands another nude athlete, shown in a 3/4 back view, who scrapes his arm with a strigil; between them hangs an animal skin that seems to act as a shower, emitting water

img.caption: Detail of the figural scene on side A, left of center: Phoinix, bearded, leaning 3/4-view to the right on a staff, wearing slippers, a himation, and a taenia
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of the figural scene on side A, center: Achilles, swathed in a himation (covering his head), seated on a klismos, profile to the right; the klismos stands on a dais in front of a thin column
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of the figural scene on side A, right of center: an attenuated Doric column; Thetis, standing frontally, with her head profile to the left, wearing a belted peplos over a short-sleeved chiton, jewelry, and a thick taenia; she holds a spear upright in her left hand, while her right hand rests on a shield which stands slightly behind her
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of the figural scene on side A, right: a Nereid, advancing to the left, shown in 3/4-view, wearing a himation over a medium-sleeved chiton, with a kekryphylon binding her hair; she holds her left hand at waist level, and holds a Corinthian helmet in her upraised right hand
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of the figural scene on side B, left: a woman running to the left, who turns her head profile to the right, while she reaches her right hand to the left; she wears a himation over a short-sleeved chiton, and holds some of her drapery above her left shoulder
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of the figural scene on side B, left of center: a woman running to the left, with both arms upraised, who turns her head profile to the right; she wears a belted, short-sleeved chiton, and a broad stephane
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of the figural scene on side B, center: Menelaos, a youthful warrior running profile to the right, wearing greaves, a cuirass over a chitoniskos, and an Attic helmet, armed with a sword, spear, and hoplite shield
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of the figural scene on side B, right: a female figure, perhaps Aphrodite, advancing in 3/4-view to the right, with her left arm raised, reaches her right hand back to the warrior behind her, to whom she turns her head; she wears a himation over a short-sleeved chiton, and a taenia wrapped in her hair
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of the figural scene under the left handles: a woman, probably Helen, advancing in 3/4-view to the right, with her left arm raised, turns back to look behind her (to the left), and holds her left hand, as if in hesitation, just above her left shoulder
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: View of the figural scene on the stand, side A, right of center: a woman, wearing a himation over a medium-sleeved chiton, with a sakkos on her hair, stands in 3/4-view to the left, rests her left hand on her up, and holds a box in her upraised right hand

img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of neck, side A, center: an armed warrior runs to the right; a folding stool is below him; a bearded man, wearing a chlamys, holding an unidentifiable object (wreath?) in his upraised left hand, advances to the right, but turns his head profile to the left; a draped, bearded man, holding a wreath in his upraised right hand, stands profile to the right
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of neck, side A, right: an armed warrior runs to the right; a folding stool is below him; a bearded man, wearing a chlamys, holding an unidentifiable object (wreath?) in his upraised left hand, advances to the right, but turns his head profile to the left; a draped, bearded man, holding a wreath in his upraised right hand, stands profile to the right
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of body, side A, far left: a draped, bearded man stands profile to the right, with his left foot advanced, and his left hand raised, perhaps in a speaking gesture; swags of cloth decorate the wall behind him

img.caption: Detail of body, side A, left: an armed warrior, wearing greaves, a cuirass over a chitoniskos, and a helmet, and holding a taenia (over his right forearm), a spear (in his right hand), a shield (on his left forearm), and a sword (in a scabbard on his left hip) runs to the right, and turns his head profile to the left; a folding stool is below him
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of body, side A, left: a draped, bearded man advances profile to the right, holding a spear upright in his left hand

img.caption: Detail of body, side A, left of center: an armed warrior, wearing greaves, a cuirass over a chitoniskos, and a helmet, and holding a spear (in his right hand), a shield (on his left forearm), and a sword (in a scabbard on his left hip) runs profile to the right; a folding stool is below him
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of body, side A, right of center: Hermes runs to the right, and turns his head profile to the left; he wears his winged boots, a chlamys, a beard, and a petasos, and holds his kerykeion in his right hand, and a leather pouch over his left shoulder; a basket is below him
img.credits: Photograph by Maria Daniels, courtesy of the Musée du Louvre

img.caption: Detail of body, side A, far right: a youthful god (perhaps Apollo) runs profile to the left; he wears a chlamys and a taenia on his hair, and holds a spear diagonally in his left hand; a basket is below him; behind him stands a small, bearded, draped, man, in a 3/4-view to the right, although he turns his head profile to the left
